name: socratic-debugging-benchmark
description:
Socratic Debugging Benchmark
	


  


The repository contains the dataset for the Socratic Debugging Benchmark accompanying the papers "Socratic Questioning of Novice Debuggers: A Benchmark Dataset and Preliminary Evaluations" in proceedings of the 18th Workshop on Innovative Use of NLP for Building Educational Application at ACL 2023 and "Can Language Models Employ the Socratic Method? Experiments with Code Debugging" in the proceedings of SIGCSE'24.
The dataset is also hosted on… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/taisazero/socratic-debugging-benchmark.
reputation: A niche academic benchmark introduced in 2023 with moderate attention in educational NLP and debugging-research communities for studying Socratic tutoring and debugging assistance.
